name: webcon-designer-studio-mcp-skills
description: Set up configuration conventions and design, build, verify and publish WEBCON applications through the DesignerStudio MCP server.

mcp_url.title: DesignerStudio MCP server URL
mcp_url.description: MCP endpoint of your WEBCON server (the /docs link with /docs stripped), e.g. https://mcp.webconbps.com/api/mcp/server/<server id>

mcp_client_id.title: WEBCON OAuth client ID
mcp_client_id.description: Client ID of the OAuth client (API Key) your WEBCON admin pre-registered for this MCP server (Authorization Code + PKCE, user context).

mcp_client_secret.title: WEBCON OAuth client secret
mcp_client_secret.description: Client secret issued when the OAuth client was registered in WEBCON. Stored in the OS keychain, never committed.

mcp_scopes.title: WEBCON OAuth scopes
mcp_scopes.description: Exact space-separated scopes registered for this client (from the server /docs page or /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource), e.g. Mcp.Tools User.Designer.ReadWrite.All openid profile email
